references.text: The Jebusites and Amorites are among the peoples who fought against Israel, as mentioned here in Joshua's summary of God's saving acts.
The Amorites are mentioned as one of the Canaanite peoples who gathered against Israel after crossing the Jordan.
The Girgashites are mentioned as one of the nations in the land that God promised to give to Abraham's descendants.
All three groups—the Jebusites, Amorites, and Girgashites—are listed among the seven nations God promised to drive out for Israel.
God mentions, among others, the Jebusites and Amorites as peoples in the land He promised to give to Israel.
A direct parallel in the genealogy of Canaan's sons confirming the same list of peoples.
